name: Beşparmak Trail
description_md:
The Besparmak Trail is a hard waymarked hiking route in Cyprus spanning 235.0 km. It features 6814 m of ascent and 6811 m of descent as part of the national waymarked hiking network.

The walking time is about 77 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, with the difficulty rating derived from distance and ascent. This path passes the flag of Northern Cyprus within 1100 m. It also passes the Karpas Peninsula within 1500 m.
